{{Short description|Italian mathematician (died 1679)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=January 2026}}
[[File:Puglisi_-_Aritmetica,_1714_-_4660310.tif|thumb|''Aritmetica'', title page (1714)]]

'''Onofrio Puglisi''', also known as '''Onofrio Pugliesi Sbernia''' (died on 11 January 1679), was an [[Italians|Italian]] [[mathematician]] from [[Palermo]].<ref>{{Cite book|first=Giuseppe Maria|last=Mira|title=Bibliografia siciliana ovvero gran dizionario bibliografico|volume=2|location=Palermo|publisher=G. B. Gaudiano|date=1881|page=255|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=wQehAAAAMAAJ&pg=PA255|language=it}}</ref>

He was the first writer of accounting books in southern Italy.<ref>{{Cite book|first=Amintore|last=Fanfani|author-link=Amintore Fanfani|title=Economia e storia|volume=3|location=Rome|publisher=[[Fratelli Bocca]]|date=1956|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=pMYsAQAAIAAJ|page=426|language=it|quote=Onofrio Pugliesi Sbernia, che è il primo scrittore meridionale di ragioneria}}</ref>

== Works ==

* {{Cite book|title=Prattica economica numerale|trans-title=Numeral Economic Practice|location=Palermo|publisher=Agostino Bossio|date=1671|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=4Up8_icE9D0C|language=it}}
